name: Helper T cell differentiation
summary: A naive CD4⁺ T cell, activated by an antigen-presenting cell, becomes a subset set by the cytokines around it; each subset has a master transcription factor (shown as what the step needs) and its own cytokines (shown coming out). Th1 (IL-12 → T-bet → IFN-γ): macrophages, intracellular microbes. Th2 (IL-4 → GATA-3 → IL-4, IL-5, IL-13): IgE, eosinophils, helminths, allergy. Th17 (TGF-β + IL-6 → RORγt → IL-17, IL-22): neutrophils, mucosal defense. Treg (TGF-β + IL-2 → FOXP3 → TGF-β, IL-10): tolerance. Tfh (IL-6, IL-21 → BCL-6): germinal centers, B cell help.

th0.name: Naive CD4⁺ T cell
th0.notes: Activated in a lymph node by an antigen-presenting cell: MHC II with peptide on the TCR (signal 1) plus B7 (CD80/86) on CD28 (signal 2). The cytokines around it then decide what it becomes.

th1.name: Th1 cell
th1.notes: Cell-mediated immunity against intracellular microbes (mycobacteria, fungi): IFN-γ activates macrophages and drives IgG class switching. Type IV hypersensitivity and granulomas. Its IFN-γ inhibits Th2; IL-4 and IL-10 inhibit it. IL-12 receptor or IFN-γ receptor defects: disseminated mycobacterial infection.

th2.name: Th2 cell
th2.notes: Humoral and anti-helminth immunity, allergy and asthma: IL-4 and IL-13 switch B cells to IgE, IL-5 recruits and activates eosinophils (and IgA). Its IL-4 and IL-10 inhibit Th1; IFN-γ inhibits it.

th17.name: Th17 cell
th17.notes: Mucosal and skin defense against extracellular bacteria and fungi (Candida): IL-17 recruits neutrophils, IL-22 keeps barriers up. Drives autoimmune inflammation (psoriasis, IBD, MS). Inhibited by IFN-γ and IL-4. Hyper-IgE (Job) syndrome: STAT3 defect, no Th17, so cold staph abscesses and candidiasis.

treg.name: Regulatory T cell
treg.notes: CD4⁺ CD25⁺ (CD25 = IL-2 receptor α) FOXP3⁺: keep self-reactive T cells quiet (peripheral tolerance) with TGF-β, IL-10 and IL-35. FOXP3 mutation: IPEX syndrome (immune dysregulation, polyendocrinopathy, enteropathy, X-linked).

tfh.name: Follicular helper T cell
tfh.notes: Helps B cells in germinal centers: CD40L on its surface binds CD40 on the B cell, and IL-21 and IL-4 drive class switching and affinity maturation.

e_th1.name: IL-12 (+ IFN-γ)
e_th1.notes: IL-12 comes from macrophages and dendritic cells; IFN-γ reinforces it.

e_th2.name: IL-4 (+ IL-2)
e_th2.notes: IL-4 (from Th2 cells, mast cells, basophils) is the decisive one.

e_th17.name: TGF-β + IL-6 (+ IL-23)
e_th17.notes: TGF-β with IL-6 makes Th17 cells (TGF-β alone makes Tregs); IL-23 keeps them going.
